blockingFindings.title: Cryptographic-looking caller candidateRef is not proven to be bound to the actual material candidate
blockingFindings.requiredRevision: Prove a minimal trusted candidate-identity producer/attestation seam and the stale-ref counterexample. Arbitrary caller text must not become same-candidate reuse authority merely because it matches a hash grammar.

blockingFindings.title: Material environment identity does not currently invalidate reusable check facts
blockingFindings.requiredRevision: Bind explicit materially relevant environment identity into checkRef or compare it separately during reuse, and prove an environment change forces rerun.

blockingFindings.title: Closed required-check execution/admission input seam is still deferred to Proposal
blockingFindings.requiredRevision: Freeze one bounded closed input contract tied to exact ActionPackage/run identity so execution and Result admission consume the same declared checks/candidate identity and fail closed on omission, duplication, or mismatch.

checks.stopDiscipline: REVISE ONLY THE THREE BINDING PROOFS

revisionGuidance: Do not add candidate snapshot DB, temp Git authority, Registry, Planner, Evidence Platform, or history scan.
Do not reopen exact argv execution, Result.facts storage direction, or Verification authority separation.
Resolve actual candidate identity trust, material environment invalidation, and one closed execution/admission input seam.
Add decisive stale-candidateRef, changed-environment, and execution/admission-plan mismatch counterexamples.
